about: The freeze of the grown sweep: each file's SHA-256 as it stood before any job of it was stepped, held by test_grown_frozen.py. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
on_whose_word: the maintainer's, to the cloud session: "come up with the next few and run them"
against: demo/shared-runs/study/runs, for the 220 jobs the first study also ran

rules.G1: passes when every folder is whole by its seal, its log holds, its seal's signature holds, and its signer is in the ring
rules.G2: passes when every job was done and the share of steps saved is within 2 points of the share that stepping each trajectory once, to its longest job or its halt, would save
rules.G3: passes when the checks stepped every kept state of all fifty folders again and found every one the same, and every halt the memory names halts
rules.G4: passes when each round took in its own place's earlier rounds and nothing else, each as enrolled
rules.G5: passes when no trajectory was stepped into its halt twice; none halting is not tested
rules.G6: passes when every job that is also the first study's comes to the first study's SHA-256, all 220 of them

measured: bytes that came back, by round
what the checks stepped as a share of the sweep alone
no_baseline: what the sweep would cost alone is counted from the plan and the halts the shared run finds, each of which the check steps up to
not_tested_is_not_passed: a folder that did not come back sealed leaves every rule not tested
not_frozen: the identities, which are made when the notebooks are and kept outside the repository; the Kaggle account
